name: mcp-servers-official
description: The canonical repository of reference MCP servers from the Model Context Protocol organization. Includes filesystem, memory, git, fetch, time, and everything servers demonstrating the reference implementations. The single most-starred MCP project on GitHub.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "mcp-servers-official" -> command: npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory (or run: hermes mcp add mcp-servers-official -- npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory)
For Python servers: uvx mcp-server-git (git server) or pip install mcp-server-git
On Windows wrap npx with: cmd /c npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: codebase-memory-mcp
description: High-performance MCP server that indexes codebases into a persistent knowledge graph, giving AI agents deep code understanding across large repositories. Reduces hallucinations by grounding agents in real symbol-level code context. Supports incremental indexing and natural-language queries over the codebase.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "codebase-memory-mcp" -> command: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp/main/install.sh | bash (or run: hermes mcp add codebase-memory-mcp -- curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp/main/install.sh | bash)
Alternative: npm install -g codebase-memory-mcp@latest or pip install -U codebase-memory-mcp
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: playwright-mcp
description: Official Microsoft Playwright MCP server that lets AI agents control Chromium/Firefox/WebKit browsers with accessibility-tree based interaction. Enables navigation, clicking, form filling, screenshots, and network interception. The most widely used browser-automation MCP server.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "playwright-mcp" -> command: npx @playwright/mcp@latest --config path/to/config.json (or run: hermes mcp add playwright-mcp -- npx @playwright/mcp@latest --config path/to/config.json)
Basic run: npx @playwright/mcp@latest
Optional: set --headless for CI environments
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: github-mcp-server
description: GitHub's official MCP server exposing repository, issue, PR, search, and Actions tools to AI agents. Runs as a Docker container talking to the GitHub REST API. Requires a GitHub Personal Access Token for authenticated operations.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "github-mcp-server" -> command: docker run -i --rm -e GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server (or run: hermes mcp add github-mcp-server -- docker run -i --rm -e GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server)
Set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN env var (classic PAT or fine-grained token)
Example client line: claude mcp add github -e GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN=$GITHUB_PAT -- docker run -i --rm -e GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: mcp-toolbox-databases
description: Google MCP Toolbox for Databases: an open-source MCP server giving AI agents unified SQL access to Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, BigQuery, and Cloud Spanner. Provides a single toolbox server for querying across Google database platforms. Supports safe read-only and guided DDL/DML workflows.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "mcp-toolbox-databases" -> command: npx @toolbox-sdk/server --config tools.yaml (or run: hermes mcp add mcp-toolbox-databases -- npx @toolbox-sdk/server --config tools.yaml)
Create a tools.yaml config declaring target databases
Authenticate via gcloud application-default credentials (ADC)
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: figma-context-mcp
description: MCP server that provides Figma layout information (frames, nodes, coordinates, styles) to AI coding agents like Cursor and Claude. Lets agents turn Figma designs directly into code by querying live design data. Requires a Figma API key.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "figma-context-mcp" -> command: npx -y figma-developer-mcp --figma-api-key=YOUR-KEY --stdio (or run: hermes mcp add figma-context-mcp -- npx -y figma-developer-mcp --figma-api-key=YOUR-KEY --stdio)
Set FIGMA_API_KEY env var to a Figma personal access token
Config example uses command "npx" args ["-y","figma-developer-mcp","--figma-api-key=YOUR-KEY","--stdio"]
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: mcp-chrome
description: Chrome MCP Server: a Chrome-extension-based MCP server that exposes the user's real browser to AI agents. Works with the user's logged-in sessions and avoids bot detection by driving an actual Chrome profile. Install via the mcp-chrome-bridge npm package.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "mcp-chrome" -> command: npm install -g mcp-chrome-bridge (or run: hermes mcp add mcp-chrome -- npm install -g mcp-chrome-bridge)
Install the companion Chrome extension in the browser
Run the bridge server, then connect MCP client to it
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: pal-mcp-server
description: Beehive Innovations PAL MCP server that gives AI agents orchestrated access to Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Codex CLI plus multiple LLM providers (Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Azure). Lets a single agent drive multiple coding CLIs and model backends. Run via uvx from the git repo.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "pal-mcp-server" -> command: uvx --from git+https://github.com/BeehiveInnovations/pal-mcp-server.git pal-mcp-server (or run: hermes mcp add pal-mcp-server -- uvx --from git+https://github.com/BeehiveInnovations/pal-mcp-server.git pal-mcp-server)
Requires uv/uvx installed (curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh)
Configure provider API keys (Gemini/OpenAI/OpenRouter/Azure) as env vars
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: hexstrike-ai
description: HexStrike AI MCP server that gives AI agents (Claude, GPT, Copilot) cybersecurity tooling: port scanning, subdomain enumeration, web recon, and penetration-testing workflows. Bundles a suite of offensive-security tools behind an MCP interface. Clone the repo and run the Python server.
install_command: git clone https://github.com/0x4m4/hexstrike-ai.git && cd hexstrike-ai && pip install -r requirements.txt && python3 hexstrike_server.py --port 8888
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "hexstrike-ai" -> command: git clone https://github.com/0x4m4/hexstrike-ai.git && cd hexstrike-ai && pip install -r requirements.txt && python3 hexstrike_server.py --port 8888 (or run: hermes mcp add hexstrike-ai -- git clone https://github.com/0x4m4/hexstrike-ai.git && cd hexstrike-ai && pip install -r requirements.txt && python3 hexstrike_server.py --port 8888)
Install Python 3.10+ and pip dependencies from requirements.txt
Run server with python3 hexstrike_server.py --port 8888
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: ghidramcp
description: LaurieWired GhidraMCP bridges the Ghidra SRE framework to AI agents via MCP, exposing decompilation, function analysis, and binary inspection tools. Installed as a Ghidra extension with a Python bridge server. Powerful for malware analysis and CTF reverse engineering.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "ghidramcp" -> command: python /ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO/bridge_mcp_ghidra.py (or run: hermes mcp add ghidramcp -- python /ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO/bridge_mcp_ghidra.py)
Install Ghidra and add the GhidraMCP extension via File > Install Extensions
Run bridge_mcp_ghidra.py then add server with command "python" and arg path to bridge script
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: awslabs-mcp
description: Open-source collection of AWS MCP servers covering API Gateway, IaC, documentation, and MySQL/RDS operations. Each server runs via uvx with the awslabs.* naming convention. Lets agents manage AWS resources and query AWS docs directly.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "awslabs-mcp" -> command: uvx awslabs.aws-api-mcp-server@latest (or run: hermes mcp add awslabs-mcp -- uvx awslabs.aws-api-mcp-server@latest)
Examples: claude mcp add aws-api uvx awslabs.aws-api-mcp-server@latest; aws-iac uvx awslabs.aws-iac-mcp-server@latest
Requires AWS credentials configured (env or ~/.aws/credentials)
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: desktop-commander-mcp
description: DesktopCommander MCP gives Claude and other agents terminal control, file system search, diff viewing, and text editing on the host machine. Includes safety approvals and command-timeout controls. Setup is one npx command.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "desktop-commander-mcp" -> command: npx @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander@latest setup (or run: hermes mcp add desktop-commander-mcp -- npx @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander@latest setup)
The setup command auto-configures the server in Claude Code
For manual config: npx @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander@latest with stdio transport
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: git-mcp
description: GitMCP by idosal is a free remote MCP server that serves any public GitHub repository's code context to AI agents without local setup. Point an agent at a repo URL and it fetches codebase context on demand. Eliminates code hallucination by grounding in the real repo.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "git-mcp" -> command: npx mcp-remote https://gitmcp.io/{owner}/{repo} (or run: hermes mcp add git-mcp -- npx mcp-remote https://gitmcp.io/{owner}/{repo})
Point at any public repo: https://gitmcp.io/<owner>/<repo>
Remote server - no local install beyond mcp-remote client
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: firecrawl-mcp-server
description: Official Firecrawl MCP server adding powerful web scraping, crawling, and search to Cursor, Claude, and other clients. Converts websites to LLM-ready markdown and runs site-wide crawls. Requires a Firecrawl API key (free tier available).
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "firecrawl-mcp-server" -> command: env FIRECRAWL_API_KEY=fc-YOUR_API_KEY npx -y firecrawl-mcp (or run: hermes mcp add firecrawl-mcp-server -- env FIRECRAWL_API_KEY=fc-YOUR_API_KEY npx -y firecrawl-mcp)
Set FIRECRAWL_API_KEY env var (get at firecrawl.dev)
Windows: cmd /c "set FIRECRAWL_API_KEY=your-api-key && npx -y firecrawl-mcp"
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: browsermcp
description: Browser MCP is an MCP server plus Chrome extension that automates the user's real browser, keeping logged-in sessions and avoiding bot detection. Fast local automation without network latency, with the user's real fingerprint. Adapted from Playwright MCP for personal-browser use.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "browsermcp" -> command: npx @browsermcp/mcp (or run: hermes mcp add browsermcp -- npx @browsermcp/mcp)
Install the Browser MCP Chrome extension from browsermcp.io
Run npx @browsermcp/mcp then connect client; keep extension enabled
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: windows-mcp
description: CursorTouch Windows-MCP gives AI agents computer-use control over Windows desktops: GUI automation, file operations, and app interaction. Exposes native Windows automation capabilities over MCP. Run the server via uvx.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "windows-mcp" -> command: uvx windows-mcp serve (or run: hermes mcp add windows-mcp -- uvx windows-mcp serve)
Runs on Windows host; uv/uvx required
Grant screen/automation permissions when prompted
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: xcodebuild-mcp
description: Sentry XcodeBuildMCP is an MCP server and CLI that helps AI agents build, test, and analyze Xcode projects. Provides tools for building schemes, running tests, and parsing build output. Requires a Mac with Xcode installed.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "xcodebuild-mcp" -> command: npx -y xcodebuildmcp@latest init (or run: hermes mcp add xcodebuild-mcp -- npx -y xcodebuildmcp@latest init)
Mac + Xcode required
The init command configures the server for the current Xcode project
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: whatsapp-mcp
description: WhatsApp MCP server lets AI agents send and receive WhatsApp messages through a local bridge. Runs a Go QR-authenticated bridge plus a uv-based Python MCP server. Supports text, images, and audio (FFmpeg for voice notes).
install_command: git clone https://github.com/lharries/whatsapp-mcp.git && cd whatsapp-mcp && uv sync && uv run whatsapp-mcp-server
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "whatsapp-mcp" -> command: git clone https://github.com/lharries/whatsapp-mcp.git && cd whatsapp-mcp && uv sync && uv run whatsapp-mcp-server (or run: hermes mcp add whatsapp-mcp -- git clone https://github.com/lharries/whatsapp-mcp.git && cd whatsapp-mcp && uv sync && uv run whatsapp-mcp-server)
First run: scan the QR code with the WhatsApp mobile app to authenticate the bridge (go run main.go in whatsapp-bridge/)
Windows note: go-sqlite3 needs CGO enabled + a C compiler
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: bb-browser
description: bb-browser turns your browser into an API: a CLI plus MCP server that lets AI agents drive Chrome using your existing logged-in sessions. Designed for agentic browsing with your real profile. Install globally via npm.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "bb-browser" -> command: npm install -g bb-browser (or run: hermes mcp add bb-browser -- npm install -g bb-browser)
Launch with the bb-browser CLI, then expose MCP endpoint to client
Uses your existing Chrome login sessions
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: mobile-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server for mobile automation and scraping on iOS, Android, and emulators. Lets AI agents interact with mobile apps, capture screens, and extract data from devices. Useful for mobile QA and app testing agents.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "mobile-mcp" -> command: npx @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest (or run: hermes mcp add mobile-mcp -- npx @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest)
Connect a device/emulator via adb (Android) or XCUITest (iOS)
Server discovers connected devices automatically
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: mcp-atlassian
description: MCP server for Atlassian tools: Confluence space/wiki search, page ops, and Jira issue management for AI agents. Configures one or both products via environment variables. Popular for team documentation and ticketing workflows.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "mcp-atlassian" -> command: uvx mcp-atlassian (or run: hermes mcp add mcp-atlassian -- uvx mcp-atlassian)
Set CONFLUENCE_URL + CONFLUENCE_EMAIL + CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN (and/or JIRA_URL, JIRA_EMAIL, JIRA_API_TOKEN)
uvx mcp-atlassian --all-confluence --all-jira to enable both
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: executeautomation-playwright
description: Playwright MCP server from Execute Automation for automating browsers and APIs in Claude Desktop and other clients. Wraps Playwright for navigation, interaction, and API testing. A long-standing popular alternative to the official Playwright MCP.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "executeautomation-playwright" -> command: npx @executeautomation/playwright-mcp-server (or run: hermes mcp add executeautomation-playwright -- npx @executeautomation/playwright-mcp-server)
npx @executeautomation/playwright-mcp-server with stdio transport
Older install path: npx @michaellatman/mcp-get@latest install @executeautomation/playwright-mcp-server
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: agent-infra-sandbox
description: All-in-One Sandbox for AI agents combining browser, shell, file, MCP, and VSCode server in one Docker container. Gives agents a safe, isolated execution environment with an API key gate. Runs as a single Docker image with an HTTP API.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "agent-infra-sandbox" -> command: docker run --security-opt seccomp=unconfined --rm -it -e SANDBOX_API_KEY=your-secret-key -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 ghcr.io/agent-infra/sandbox:latest (or run: hermes mcp add agent-infra-sandbox -- docker run --security-opt seccomp=unconfined --rm -it -e SANDBOX_API_KEY=your-secret-key -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 ghcr.io/agent-infra/sandbox:latest)
Set SANDBOX_API_KEY (services stay open without it for backwards compat)
Access via X-AIO-API-Key header or ?api_key= query param
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: godot-mcp
description: MCP server for interfacing with the Godot game engine: launching the editor, running scenes, and inspecting the game tree from AI agents. Lets agents drive Godot projects during development. Configurable with GODOT_PATH and debug flags.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "godot-mcp" -> command: npx @coding-solo/godot-mcp (or run: hermes mcp add godot-mcp -- npx @coding-solo/godot-mcp)
claude mcp add godot -e GODOT_PATH=/path/to/godot -e DEBUG=true -- npx @coding-solo/godot-mcp
Requires Godot 4.x installed locally
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: peekaboo
description: Peekaboo is a macOS CLI and optional MCP server that lets AI agents capture screenshots and screen recordings. Also provides vision analysis helpers for agents working on Mac. Useful for computer-use and UI-testing agents on macOS.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "peekaboo" -> command: npx -y @steipete/peekaboo --version (or run: hermes mcp add peekaboo -- npx -y @steipete/peekaboo --version)
Run npx -y @steipete/peekaboo --serve to start MCP server mode
Grant Screen Recording permission in macOS System Settings
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: exa-mcp-server
description: Exa MCP for web search and web crawling: neural search over the live web with content extraction to markdown. Can be used via Exa's hosted remote server (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) or the local npm package. Requires an Exa API key.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "exa-mcp-server" -> command: npx -y exa-mcp-server@latest (or run: hermes mcp add exa-mcp-server -- npx -y exa-mcp-server@latest)
Set EXA_API_KEY env var (exa.ai dashboard)
Hosted alternative: point client at https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp with EXA_API_KEY
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: deep-research
description: Use any LLM for deep research with SSE API and MCP server support. Runs research agents that query multiple sources and compile reports, deployable via Docker. Bring-your-own-LLM with configurable providers.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "deep-research" -> command: docker run -d --name deep-research -p 3333:3000 xiangfa/deep-research (or run: hermes mcp add deep-research -- docker run -d --name deep-research -p 3333:3000 xiangfa/deep-research)
Set LLM provider keys (OpenAI/Anthropic/etc.) via env vars
Access UI/API at http://localhost:3333, MCP endpoint exposed too
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: notion-mcp-server
description: Official Notion MCP server giving AI agents access to Notion pages, databases, and search. Enables creating pages, querying databases, and updating content programmatically. Requires a Notion integration token.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "notion-mcp-server" -> command: npx @notionhq/notion-mcp-server (or run: hermes mcp add notion-mcp-server -- npx @notionhq/notion-mcp-server)
Set NOTION_TOKEN env var (create an integration at notion.so/my-integrations)
Grant the integration access to the target workspace/pages
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: ha-mcp
description: The unofficial Home Assistant MCP server connecting AI agents to your smart home: lights, sensors, switches, and automations. Runs via uvx/PyPI, Docker, or a Home Assistant custom component. Requires Home Assistant URL and long-lived token.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "ha-mcp" -> command: uvx ha-mcp@latest (or run: hermes mcp add ha-mcp -- uvx ha-mcp@latest)
Set HOMEASSISTANT_URL and HOMEASSISTANT_TOKEN (long-lived access token)
Configure exactly one install method per client (uvx vs add-on vs component)
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: mcp-server-chart
description: AntV MCP server for charting: exposes 25+ chart types (from Ant Design Charts) that AI agents can render from data. Pairs with chart-visualization skills for polished data-viz output. Great for agent-generated dashboards and reports.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "mcp-server-chart" -> command: npx -y @antv/mcp-server-chart (or run: hermes mcp add mcp-server-chart -- npx -y @antv/mcp-server-chart)
Config: command npx, args ["-y","@antv/mcp-server-chart"]
Optionally add antvis/chart-visualization-skills via npx skills add
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: spec-workflow-mcp
description: MCP server providing structured spec-driven development workflows: drafting specs, tracking tasks, and validating implementation against requirements. Helps agents follow plan-spec-implement loops. Includes a dashboard mode.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "spec-workflow-mcp" -> command: npx -y @pimzino/spec-workflow-mcp@latest --dashboard (or run: hermes mcp add spec-workflow-mcp -- npx -y @pimzino/spec-workflow-mcp@latest --dashboard)
Run without --dashboard for headless stdio mode
Dashboard flag serves a local review UI
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: mcp-obsidian
description: MCP server that interacts with Obsidian through the Obsidian Local REST API community plugin: read/write notes, search vault, and manage markdown. Popular way to give agents access to a knowledge base. Requires the Local REST API plugin enabled.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "mcp-obsidian" -> command: uvx mcp-obsidian (or run: hermes mcp add mcp-obsidian -- uvx mcp-obsidian)
Enable the "Local REST API" community plugin in Obsidian and set an API key
Config: command uvx, args ["mcp-obsidian"] (or uv --directory /path/to/mcp-obsidian run mcp-obsidian)
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: excel-mcp-server
description: MCP server for Excel file manipulation: read, write, and transform .xlsx files from AI agents. Supports formulas, sheets, and formatting operations. Runs via uvx with stdio transport.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "excel-mcp-server" -> command: uvx excel-mcp-server stdio (or run: hermes mcp add excel-mcp-server -- uvx excel-mcp-server stdio)
Point at target .xlsx paths via tools at runtime
Use "stdio" transport arg for local MCP clients
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

description: Cloudflare MCP servers exposing Cloudflare services to agents: docs search, Workers bindings/builds, observability, containers, browser rendering, logpush, AI gateway, DNS analytics, and more. Hosted stateless servers at *.mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp endpoints.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "cloudflare-mcp-server" -> command: https://docs.mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp (remote URL) (or run: hermes mcp add cloudflare-mcp-server -- https://docs.mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp (remote URL))
Connect client as remote MCP (Streamable HTTP) to a chosen endpoint e.g. https://docs.mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp
OAuth/credentials and account selection handled by Cloudflare

name: tradingview-mcp
description: TradingView MCP server providing real-time market data, technical analysis, screeners, and backtesting to AI agents. Covers stocks, crypto, forex, and futures. Free to use with TradingView public data.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "tradingview-mcp" -> command: pip install tradingview-mcp-server (or run: hermes mcp add tradingview-mcp -- pip install tradingview-mcp-server)
No API key required for core data tools
Optionally run via uvx tradingview-mcp-server
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: mcp-feedback-enhanced
description: Enhanced MCP server for interactive user feedback and command execution in AI-assisted development. Adds approval flows and structured feedback loops for agent actions. Useful for safer agentic coding.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "mcp-feedback-enhanced" -> command: uvx mcp-feedback-enhanced@latest (or run: hermes mcp add mcp-feedback-enhanced -- uvx mcp-feedback-enhanced@latest)
Runs stdio; no API key required
Use version subcommand to verify install: uvx mcp-feedback-enhanced@latest version
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: laravel-boost

connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "laravel-boost" -> command: composer require laravel/boost --dev && php artisan boost:install (or run: hermes mcp add laravel-boost -- composer require laravel/boost --dev && php artisan boost:install)
Requires a Laravel 11+ project with Composer
Documentation: laravel.com/docs/boost
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: browserbase-mcp
description: Browserbase MCP server lets LLMs control cloud-hosted browsers via Browserbase and Stagehand: navigation, extraction, and agentic browsing at scale. Runs headless browsers in the cloud with session recording. Requires Browserbase API key (free tier available).
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "browserbase-mcp" -> command: npx @browserbasehq/mcp (or run: hermes mcp add browserbase-mcp -- npx @browserbasehq/mcp)
Set BROWSERBASE_API_KEY and BROWSERBASE_PROJECT_ID env vars (browserbase.com)
Optional GEMINI_API_KEY for Stagehand vision features
Restart Hermes (or reload), then verify: hermes mcp list

name: mcp-grafana
description: MCP server for Grafana: query dashboards, datasources, incidents, and on-call from AI agents. Lets agents pull metrics and investigate alerts across Grafana stack. Configure via environment variables.
connect_steps: Add to Hermes config.yaml mcp_servers: "mcp-grafana" -> command: uvx mcp-grafana (or run: hermes mcp add mcp-grafana -- uvx mcp-grafana)
